evidence.artifactText: The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands
evidence.statement: The official Prada Group careers portal states that the Group operates the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands; its result table names the employing brand of each posting in the Brand column.
